title: The Silent Radio
scene: At 7:15 AM, the station microphone was unplugged. The transmitter room was sealed for testing from 7:00 to 7:30.

suspects.name: Anita Fenn
suspects.testimony: I was reading news on air at 7:15.
suspects.alibiProof: The broadcast log shows Anita's voice from 7:12 to 7:18.

suspects.name: Barry Cole
suspects.testimony: I was in the transmitter room at 7:15, running the test.
suspects.contradiction: The transmitter was locked from outside at 7:02, and the mic cable was coiled in Barry's bag.

suspects.name: Carla Voss
suspects.testimony: I was cueing guests in the booth at 7:15.
suspects.alibiProof: The booth camera shows Carla with cue cards at 7:14.

suspects.name: Devon Reed
suspects.testimony: I was fetching coffee from the cafe at 7:15.
suspects.alibiProof: The cafe receipt for Devon is stamped 7:16.
